about: Glybosay (acarbose), by brand name only, is supplied nine times from January to September 2026 to a 73-year-old woman.
Acarbose (Glybosay) 100 mg is supplied three times from January to March 2026 to a 68-year-old man, in the middle of a 14-month history.
Acarbose (Glybosay) is supplied every month, but the patient is 58 years old, so she is not an older person and the criterion is not met.
